channel.title: The Golf Channel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Lucas Glover elected chair of Player Advisory Council
item.description: Lucas Glover joined Golf Today to talk about his election to chairman of the Player Advisory Council and why he felt now was the right time in his life to serve on the PAC. Glover addressed reports that this was his 10th time trying to get elected.

item.title: McIlroy sees wet course conditions as biggest hurdle at Genesis
item.description: Golf Channel's Todd Lewis spoke to world No. 2 Rory McIlroy ahead of the 2026 Genesis Invitational. McIlroy said he appreciates the strategy part of playing at Riviera Country Club, stressing that getting the ball in the fairway is not as important this week given the current wet conditions of the course.

item.title: Masters winners: Full list of champions, scores, results and records
item.description: The players who have prevailed at the Masters Tournament, from 1934-2025, and their winning scores.

item.title: Riviera course updates, Hovland's floaties and Spieth's Genesis chances: Romine
item.description: Golf Channel's Brentley Romine gives a course update on Riviera Country Club two years removed from its last time hosting the Genesis Invitational. He also opens up his reporter's notebook to discuss the origins of Viktor Hovland's pool floaties and what Jordan Spieth is doing to prepare for the PGA Tour's second signature event this week.

item.title: What to expect from PGA Tour schedule changes, and when
item.description: Golf Channel's Todd Lewis reports from Riviera Country Club in Pacific Palisades, Calif. where an informal players meeting on Tuesday night discussed what the future of the PGA Tour schedule could look like and when the new calendar could be announced. Lewis also discusses Lucas Glover being elected chair of the 2026 Player Advisory Council.

item.title: Men who have completed three legs of the career Grand Slam in golf
item.description: Twelve players have won three of four men's professional major championships in their careers, including three active players.

item.title: Scheffler talks Round 1 struggles, return to Riviera
item.description: World No. 1 Scottie Scheffler spoke to Golf Channel's Todd Lewis ahead of the 2026 Genesis Invitational, discussing the Tour's return to Riviera Country Club and how important it is to get a better start on Thursday this week. The 20-time PGA Tour also shared his vision for one day designing a golf course of his own.

item.title: Rory McIlroy to skip Cognizant Classic, set for Augusta return after Genesis Invitational
item.description: Rory McIlroy told Golf Channel's Todd Lewis on Wednesday that he will go directly from Riviera Country Club to Augusta next week, skipping the Cognizant Classic in The Palm Beaches.

item.title: TGR Foundation turning 30, partnering with Los Angeles Chargers
item.description: Los Angeles Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh talks about Lulu's Place and how the TGR Foundation has had an impact over the last 30 years helping inner-city kids in Los Angeles.

item.title: Scottie Scheffler looks to do one thing that Tiger Woods never has — win at Riviera
item.description: Scheffler, like Tiger Woods — and, to this point, Rory McIlroy — has not won a PGA Tour event at Riviera Country Club.
